verdicts.summary: [L] states no counterpart of what [M] prints.
evidence: [M] prints three choices: 64K^2 <= C_l, 10^5 K^6 (1+C_{l+1})^2 <= ell_l^{1/8}, and 1+2C_l <= ell_l^{1/40}; the first two are roomCost and Bank (puffs L = L^(1/8)), produced by Bid.buffer. For the third, [L] never fixes 1+2C <= L^(1/40): Tones.tuned only assumes `(1+2*columns)*η ≤ barunit` for abstract η, and the closest concrete production, Doors.pre_tilt/afford, gives Buys.tiny `rate L*(1+columns_{m+1})*orbitCost ≤ barunit L` with rate = L^(-2/5), barunit = L^(-3/8), i.e. (1+C_{m+1})*orbitCost <= L^(1/40), which is a different constant/index and does not imply 1+2C_l <= ell_l^{1/40} (orbitCost is only >= 1). One clause of the item has no counterpart, so no-match stands; it is not a typo, since the exponent 1/40 = 2/5 - 3/8 is correct and the gap is the missing clause.

[M] prints three inequalities: 64K_{J_l+1}^2<=C_l, 10^5 K^6(1+C_{l+1})^2<=ell_l^{1/8}, and 1+2C_l<=ell_l^{1/40}. roomCost and Bank (with puffs L = L^(1/8)) state the first two. The third has no counterpart: Tones only assumes '(1+2*columns)*eta <= barunit (block i)' for an abstract eta, and its proof uses this directly, never a 1/40 power of ell, so the claim stands. This is not a typo in [M], since [M] uses it later as (1+2C_i)eta_i<=epsilon_i with eta_i=ell_i^{-2/5}.
